title: GATE 2027 - Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering

requirements.text: Undergraduate-level subjects in Engineering/Technology across 30 test papers including new Robotics and Automation (RA)
Civil Engineering (CE) paper
Electrical Engineering (EE) paper
Mechanical / Electronics papers
General Aptitude section common to every paper
Registration through DigiLocker mandatory for all Indian nationals; registration 2 September to 5 October 2026
Exams 6-7, 13-14, 20-21 February 2027; results 19 March 2027; score valid 3 years for M.Tech admission and PSU recruitment

title: M.Tech admission to IISc and IITs via Common Offer Acceptance Portal (COAP)
company: IIT Roorkee (COAP 2026 coordinating institute) with IISc and 23 IITs
experience_text: Fresher / final-year eligible with valid GATE score

requirements.text: A candidate should have a valid GATE score (qualified in GATE 2026, 2025 or 2024)
Valid GATE score in Electrical Engineering for EE programmes
Valid GATE score in Mechanical/Electronics for ME/ECE programmes
Candidates must be Indian Nationals
Register on COAP (free) and apply separately to each participating institute (IISc + 23 IITs, plus NPCIL)
Round 1 offers 11 May 2026 (10 am) to 13 May 2026 (9 am); choose the most preferred M.Tech offer across rounds

title: Centralized Counselling for M.Tech./M.Arch./M.Plan. Admissions (CCMT 2026) - NITs, IIEST, IIITs, CFTIs
experience_text: Fresher / final-year eligible with valid GATE score

requirements.text: GATE score of years 2024, 2025 and 2026 accepted
Valid GATE Civil Engineering score for Civil M.Tech specialisations
Valid GATE Electrical Engineering score for Electrical M.Tech specialisations
Bachelor's degree with CGPA/percentage as per brochure (CGPA considered when both are on the mark sheet)
Online registration, choice filling and seat allotment rounds on ccmt.admissions.nic.in (registration from 15 May)
Participating institutes: NITs, IIEST Shibpur and some IIITs and CFTIs

title: DAAD Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines (2027/28)
salary_text: Monthly payment EUR 992 for students plus travel allowance; no repayment

requirements.text: Read the call for applications for the chosen scholarship programme in the DAAD scholarship database and observe the deadline
Selection on professional qualifications and quality of the study project
Potential of the applicant assessed by selection committee (motivation, study plan)
Apply through the DAAD application portal for a Master's course in Germany
Language requirements per programme (German-taught courses require German proficiency)

title: German university applications for Winter Semester 2027/28 via uni-assist

requirements.text: The application deadline is often July 15th if the course starts in the winter semester
Apply at least 8 weeks before the deadline expires; evaluation takes 4 to 6 weeks
Find out the specific deadlines for your chosen course from your chosen university (requirements differ)
Upload certificates and transcripts for evaluation (VPD) through the uni-assist portal
Language certificate as required by the course (German or English)

title: Postgraduate taught (M.Sc./M.Eng.) September 2027 intake - Trinity College Dublin

requirements.text: At least a 2.1 honors degree from an Irish university or equivalent result from a university in another country
Official evidence of English language competency (IELTS or equivalent accepted qualifications)
Some programmes require additional assessments or interviews; check the course page
Apply through the my.tcd.ie online application portal; course-specific closing dates on each course page
Postgraduate work is very academically challenging; strong academic record expected

title: Graduate taught programmes September 2027 intake - University College Dublin

requirements.text: A recognised bachelor's degree at second class honours, grade one (2:1), or equivalent
IELTS Academic minimum score of 6.5 with not less than 6.0 in any strand
Some programmes require higher standards; verify programme-specific requirements on the UCD School website
Apply online through the UCD application portal (Apply Now / Course Search)
Recognition of Prior Learning may award credit for prior learning

title: Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 - admission to IIM PGP/MBA 2027-29

requirements.text: Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/PwD); final-year students eligible
Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension, Data Interpretation & Logical Reasoning, Quantitative Ability sections
Registration 3 August to 15 September 2026 at iimcat.ac.in; fee Rs 2,700 (Rs 1,350 SC/ST/PwD)
Exam on 29 November 2026 in three sessions at about 170 test centres
IIM shortlisting followed by Written Ability Test / Personal Interview rounds
